# The content is a JSON string value, let me extract it properly
content_start = 85991
content = await CONTEXT.read(content_start, 6000)
# Find the content parameter value
# It starts after "content": "
content_begin = content.find('"content": "')
if content_begin >= 0:
    # Skip past the key and opening quote
    content_start2 = content_begin + len('"content": "')
    # Find the end of the content (before the closing quote and comma)
    # The content ends with \n"}
    content_end2 = content.find('\\n"}', content_start2)
    if content_end2 < 0:
        content_end2 = content.find('"}', content_start2)
    if content_end2 < 0:
        content_end2 = content.find('[result 32]', content_start2)
    full_content = content[content_start2:content_end2]
    # Unescape
    full_content = full_content.replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\t', '\t').replace('\\"', '"')
    print(f"Full content length: {len(full_content)}")
    # Find the Iter class
    iter_idx = full_content.find("class Iter")
    if iter_idx >= 0:
        # Find the end of the Iter class
        # Look for the next top-level class or end of file
        rest = full_content[iter_idx:]
        # Find the next class definition or end
        next_class = rest.find("\nclass ")
        if next_class > 0:
            iter_class = rest[:next_class]
        else:
            iter_class = rest
        print(iter_class)
        print("---")
        print(f"Has __repr__: {'__repr__' in iter_class}")
